title: Speeding Ball
desc: Speeding Ball is a one-stroke arcade golf challenge. Each hole gives you a single chance to calculate direction and power, then roll the ball into the cup without a second attempt.
howto: Click or tap to aim the ball.
Release when the power feels right.
Sink the ball in one stroke to clear the hole.
tips: Treat every shot as final; there is no recovery stroke.
Use less power when the cup is close to an edge.
Line up the direction before thinking about speed.
A clean straight shot is better than a flashy bank.
